purpose.zh: 一点点拉开大腿后面和大腿根前面
purpose.en: Gradually stretches the backs of your thighs and the front of your hips.

text.zh: 一手轻扶椅子，前后腿慢慢滑开
text.en: Hold the chair lightly, slowly slide your legs apart

text.zh: 只滑到自己撑得住的地方，两边胯朝前。
text.en: Slide only as far as you can hold yourself, both hips facing forward.

text.zh: 滑到大腿后面和胯前面有拉的感觉就停。
text.en: Stop when you feel it in the back of the front leg and the front of the hip.

text.zh: 呼气时前脚再往前滑一点点，手撑住椅子分担重量。
text.en: Each breath out, slide your front foot a touch further and let the chair take weight.

commonErrors.zh: 一下滑太开，手上撑不住
commonErrors.en: Sliding too far at once so your hands can't hold you.

cautions.zh: 大腿后面或腹股沟刺疼就滑回来一点
cautions.en: If the back of your thigh or groin gets a sharp pain, slide back in.

cautions.zh: 两边椅子都要稳，地面别太滑
cautions.en: Both chairs need to be steady, and the floor not too slippery.
